thread:
alex_m: Heads-up — planning a reserved GPU pool priming for next Wed (03:00 UTC window). It's a small config change to the autoscale policy (warmup window + initial slice). Who can own the deploy and the smoke checks?
priya_s: I can do the deploy and watch the rollout. Will need someone for quick verification after slices come up.
jonathan: I can run the smoke tests and validate tail latency / token throughput for the first 2 slices. What's the safe rollback plan if we see regression?
maria-ops: Rollback is a single config revert in infra-config repo + force-restart of the pool controller. I have a prebuilt rollback runbook: /playbooks/reserved-pool-rollback.md — tested in staging.
alex_m: Thanks. Smoke checklist (short): 1) all nodes reach READY, 2) average p50 latency under 120ms for 512-token seq, 3) no >5% 5xx errors, 4) KV cache warm-hit ratio rising within 10 minutes. Can we add a quick perf query?
jonathan: I'll run these commands after deploy:
```
# verify node status
rcli pool status reserved-prod-3
# perf probes
rcli probe latency --model r-instruct-8k --seq 512 --qps 5 --duration 120
rcli metrics tail --filter "http_5xx|latency_p50|kv_cache_hit"
```
priya_s: Plan: deploy at 03:00 UTC, wait 2 min for nodes to register, run sanity probe, then jon runs perf probes. If everything OK, promote remaining slices at +10m. If anything fails, rollback immediately.
deploy-bot: :information_source: Scheduled deployment: infra-config PR #4247 merged by priya_s. Start time 1961236800. Autoposted checks enabled.
alex_m: Can we gate promotion on a single metric? e.g., require p50 < 140ms and 5xx < 1% for the first 10 minutes?
maria-ops: Yes — I set a temporary alert that will fire if those thresholds are violated and block the automated promotion. Manual override allowed with :thumbsup: from two engineers.
jonathan: I'll also watch GPU utilization; if utilization spikes >85% for 3 mins we stop.
priya_s: I'll be on-call in the channel during the window. Ping @maria-ops if rollback is needed. I'll post short logs if anything odd shows up.
alex_m: Awesome. Post-deploy: capture cost delta estimate for first 1h and attach to the rollout ticket. Also flag any model fallback events.
priya_s: Got it. I'll update ticket RW-285 and attach smoke output.
jonathan: Sounds good. I'll be ready at 03:05 UTC to start probes.
maria-ops: I'll standby for rollback and watch alerts.
priya_s: Thanks all — see you in the channel at deploy time. :rocket:
